title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-II Answer Key 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: About 5810 Graduate level NTPC posts; CBT-2 provisional answer key with response sheet
qualification: Graduation from a recognized University as per CEN 06/2025
ageLimit: As per RRB NTPC Graduate CEN
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rrb.digialm.com
2. Login with Registration Number and DOB/Password
3. Open NTPC Graduate CBT-2 Answer Key / Response Sheet
4. Download question paper, responses and key
5. Raise objections within window (around 15–22 July 2026)
shortDescription: RRB NTPC Graduate CBT-2 Answer Key 2026 out on 15 July for exam on 10 July 2026 (CEN 06/2025, ~5810 posts).
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards have released the NTPC Graduate Level CBT-2 Answer Key 2026 on 15 July 2026 for CEN 06/2025.

CBT-2 exam: 10 July 2026. Vacancies: about 5,810 graduate-level posts.

Login at rrb.digialm.com to view response sheet and raise objections within the notified dates.
